target: RK3588 not measured unless this script actually runs on that board
timing_scope: CLI wall time including process startup, image I/O, context setup and codec; warm filesystem cache; encode/decode measured separately; 2ms polling granularity
memory_scope: Sampled child-process RSS (lower bound on peak), not whole system memory
sequence_scope: Consecutive source frames; parallel_N uses frame-internal parallelism; frames_N uses -j N concurrent encoders and single-threaded decoder. Throughput is batch average, not per-frame latency
